prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in Fort Lauderdale FL to sell my house?
competitors_mentioned: Desare Kohn-Laski of Skye Louis Realty
Peter Barkin of the Barkin Group
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one universally “best” agent—the right choice depends on your home’s neighborhood, price range, and property type. Based on the available rankings and sales information, **Desare Kohn-Laski of Skye Louis Realty** is a strong first agent to interview: one ranking places her at the top for Fort Lauderdale based on verified transaction data, and reports 3,908 closed transactions overall. **Peter Barkin of the Barkin Group** is another candidate, particularly for higher-priced homes; the available profile reports 43 seller-side transactions in the past year, with listings ranging from $200,000 to $7.3 million.

Before choosing, interview two or three agents who have recently sold homes like yours nearby. Ask each for a comparable-sales-based pricing plan, examples of recent listings they personally handled, their marketing and communication plan, and their proposed commission and contract terms. A high overall sales count alone doesn’t show who will be the best fit for your specific property. ([EffectiveAgents](https://www.effectiveagents.com/fl/fort-lauderdale); [Homes.com](https://www.homes.com/real-estate-agents/peter-barkin/tmfkbjc/))
